Research

Mercury in dried market fish

Research connecting marine food products and human health

Explore the work

ProjectsResearchExpeditionsDiscuss a project

I was the first author of a peer-reviewed study examining mercury in 81 dried fish samples from Hong Kong and San Francisco.

Status: published, 2022.

Journal: Journal of Asian Health.

My role: first author; research associated with my work with Shark Stewards.

The study

The paper examines mercury in dried market fish and considers the implications for human health.

My contribution

I was the first author of the study. This work formed part of my research and communication experience with Shark Stewards from 2020 to 2022.

Publication

Vallentyne, D., Zhao, Z., Lee, T. Y., and McGuire, D. (2022). Mercury in Dried Market Fish of Hong Kong and San Francisco: Human Health Implications. Journal of Asian Health.
